data.description:
Design settled in the 2026-08-03 grill with Brandon (this description IS the settled design — build it, don't re-grill it).

Context: every piece of quiet TUI chrome currently renders identically as rev+dim — the ON HOLD bar, the INBOX bar, the footer legend (top.go:1267-1268, 1627), the history view's CANCELLED bar (1277) and footer (1613), and the task view's footer (1181). The header (listHead, 1227) is a loud rev+bold white bar. The capture: shelves vs footer vs each other are indistinguishable, and the header competes with content. Color law (render.go:12-20): 16-color ANSI only, selBG the sole sanctioned exception — this design stays inside the law; no revision needed (bright black is palette slot 8; dim is the footer's gray).

The ask — the new chrome hierarchy, loudest to quietest:
1. Header: LOSES its fill. `tuhdoo` bold; the ` · syncing with … · last fetch …` sync text dim; badge right-aligned — `watch mode` dim, `acting as <who>` normal weight (armed must be glanceable). One shared listHead serves list/history/detail, so this restyles every screen.
2. Live sections: colored bars, unchanged (magenta/green/yellow/red).
3. Awaiting attention: rev+dim bar — INBOX keeps it; task-view DESCRIPTION/HISTORY bars keep it as neutral structural chrome.
4. Shelved: NEW dark-gray filled bar — bright-black background + dim foreground (ESC[100m family; add one field to the colors struct, e.g. bgGray). Applies to ON HOLD (main list) and CANCELLED (history). Shelf rows stay dim as today — the bars alone change.
5. Footer: LOSES its fill on all three screens (list, history, task view). Plain text legend: key tokens bold, labels and `·` separators dim, done tally right-aligned dim. Pinned to the window's bottom row by padding the body with blank lines; floats only before the first WindowSizeMsg (m.height <= 0). Input-mode prompts (answer/priority/capture/edit) render pinned in the same place.

Explicitly out of scope (decided, don't drift): colored-bar right-side hints (`p priority · c cancel` etc.) stay single-style — bold keys are footer-only, because barLine pads by rune count and embedded SGRs would break it; extending bold keys into bars is a possible follow-up, not this task. No 256-color/capability-ladder use for any of this.

Acceptance:
- ON HOLD and CANCELLED bars render bright-black-bg + dim-fg; INBOX stays rev+dim; the three are visually distinct on a dark theme.
- Header and footer render unfilled per the spec above on all three screens; footer keys bold, labels dim.
- Footer (and any live input prompt) is pinned to the bottom row whenever height is known, on all three screens; the mouse hit-test counts the padding identically (hitTest replays View's layout — top.go:508-522).
- NO_COLOR / non-TTY: zero-value colors still degrade to plain text with identical geometry (existing discipline).
- Golden files regenerated for affected screens; `make test lint` green.

Pointers: cmd/tuhdoo/top.go (topSections 1255-1269, historySections 1275-1278, listHead 1217, footerView 1605, detailFooter 1163, View 1184-1211, hit-test ~508), cmd/tuhdoo/render.go (colors struct, barLine users). A styled-segment footer composer with manual visible-width tracking will be needed (embedded SGRs break barLine's rune counting; use SGR 22 semantics carefully — it clears bold AND dim).

Accepted consequences (do not relitigate): light themes mute the INBOX vs ON HOLD brightness step (ordering holds weakly); on non-256 terminals the shelf bar coincides with the selection bar's 16-color fallback (the ▌ selection gutter disambiguates); NO_COLOR flattens all differentiation, as it already does.

Constraints: boring Go (T1); 16-color law untouched; one PR per the repo conventions.
data.title: TUI chrome hierarchy: unfilled frame, shelf-gray bars, bold-key footer
